test.create_query: CREATE TABLE bench_convex_hull_circle (pt Point) ENGINE = Memory
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO bench_convex_hull_circle SELECT (cos(number * 2 * pi() / 1600000), sin(number * 2 * pi() / 1600000)) FROM numbers(1600000) SETTINGS max_threads = 1
